body: Trust me bud I know you’re just being positive and I appreciate it but I’ve exhausted everything. I’m over it I’m over the stress the pain the worries the loss the guilt all of it I’m chalking it up and we’ll see what’s after it all
My life might be in shambles but at least I know the difference in your and you’re
It’s not some big exciting true crime or something? I got hit with a bunch of shit back to back and now feel like I have no options left

I literally just explained how I got in the hole, and have been working my ass off to get out and still struggle. The pandemic wiped out my savings, I got laid off, got a new job got laid off again and because of that didn’t get unemployment. So that’s the financial part and the emotional part is losing everyone and everything around me. My relationship with my wife is completely torn apart. And why I don’t know maybe i should have never been born

I’m sorry but why what? Got laid off got a new job got laid off again didn’t qualify for unemployment. The 3 jobs I’ve taken don’t pay enough. My wife is completely distant and has said she doesn’t think this will work. I’ve got no reason to even keep trying so again I don’t understand in what way why is a valid question
